_note: Known failure 1 of SPIKES.md section 25J: with no option for this, 'make the asteroids zigzag instead of going straight' became a speed change. The operation only rewrites a thing's setup and movement code when both are exactly what a recipe wrote; anything else is Gary's, with this guide.
describe: change how something already in the game moves, like making the asteroids zigzag, bounce or go round in circles
guide: Find the lines inside the game loop that move that thing -- the for loop over its list, before screen.fill(...) -- and change only those. Keep its drawing, its colour and size constants, and what happens when the player touches it exactly as they are.

To zigzag, keep moving it across and add a small up-and-down speed that flips sign at the top and bottom edges. To bounce, give each one an x and y speed and flip each at the edges. If each one needs to remember its own direction, make that list once above the loop, next to where the things are made.
report: I changed how the $things move: they $how now.
teach: How something moves is the few lines inside the game loop that change its x and y every frame. Change those lines and the motion changes; ${prefix}_SPEED at the top still sets how fast.
